name: MILU
intro: MILU 是 Claude 系统卡中使用的印度语言多任务理解评测，用于衡量模型在多种 Indic 语言上的知识与理解能力。
org: AI4Bharat, IIT Madras, IBM Research India
build_method: 考试题收集, 清洗, 翻译补齐, 人工检查
eval_feature: Indic语言, 多学科知识, 印度文化知识
scale: 约8万道测试多选题, 8933道验证题
build_method_en: Exam-question collection, cleaning, translation gap filling, manual checks
eval_feature_en: Indic languages, multi-subject knowledge, India-centric cultural knowledge
intro_en: MILU is a Multi-task Indic Language Understanding benchmark used in Claude system cards to measure knowledge and understanding across Indic languages.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect India-centric multiple-choice questions from national, state, regional, and civil-service examinations"] --> B["Cover 11 Indian languages with English included for comparison and transfer"]
    B --> C["Organize questions into 41 subjects grouped under eight broad domains"]
    C --> D["Cap subject-language pairs and fill scarce low-resource portions by translating English questions"]
    D --> E["Clean noisy items, normalize labels, and sample questions for manual accuracy checks"]
    E --> F["Build a large test set plus a separate roughly 9,000-question validation set for few-shot examples"]
    F --> G["Evaluate proprietary, open multilingual, and Indic-specific models in zero-, one-, and five-shot settings"]
    G --> H["Report accuracy by language, subject, domain, and resource level"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从国家级、邦级、区域级和公务员考试收集印度中心多选题"] --> B["覆盖11种印度语言，并包含英文用于比较和迁移"]
    B --> C["将题目组织为八大领域下的41个学科"]
    C --> D["限制学科-语言组合规模，并用英文题翻译补足低资源部分"]
    D --> E["清洗噪声题目、规范标签，并抽样人工检查准确性"]
    E --> F["构建大型测试集和约9000题独立验证集用于few-shot示例"]
    F --> G["在零样本、一样本和五样本设置下评估闭源、多语言开源和Indic专用模型"]
    G --> H["按语言、学科、领域和资源水平报告准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.02538 / NAACL 2025. The paper introduces MILU as a Multi-task Indic Language Understanding benchmark spanning 8 domains and 41 subjects across 11 Indic/Indian languages, with India-centric material from national, state, and regional examinations covering local history, arts, festivals, laws, STEM, business, health, and governance. It reports collecting more than 150K questions, capping subject-language pairs, translating insufficient low-resource portions from English with IndicTrans2, cleaning/normalizing noisy questions, maintaining a separate validation set of about 9,000 questions, and evaluating 42 models with zero-/few-shot accuracy.
